Q953.reason: A unit past the cold-storage time limit is unsafe to give or reuse on the ward, so it goes back to the blood bank, which decides its fate and records it.

Q954.reason: Before catheterisation the patient is consented, washed, and equipment expiry is checked; contacting next of kin is outside that preparation.

Q916.reason: A 14–16 gauge cannula is a very wide bore for rapid large-volume replacement when a patient is losing volume quickly, as in trauma or burns.
